Only people whose role has **Edit the floor plan**, and managers, can change it. "}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"The screen","key":"md_the_screen","id":"the-screen","name":"md_the_screen","value":"# The screen - **Left rail**: the floors of the restaurant. **+** at the bottom adds one. - **Top bar**: the rooms of the floor (Main room, Terrace, Bar…). The badge in a room's corner is how many orders are open there. - **Center**: the tables of the room. Switch between **Plan** (the drawing) and **List** (cards with search and filters: All, Free, Seated, Reserved, Bill). Phones open in List. - **Right column**: the production centers of the floor with how many tickets wait and for how long. Tap one to open its screen. See [Production centers](/Docs/Production%20Centers)."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Table states","key":"md_table_states","id":"table-states","name":"md_table_states","value":"# Table states Each table keeps its own **color** (from its settings); its state is drawn on top of it: - **Free**: outlined in its color. - **Seated**: filled, with an amber ring and the number of open orders. - **Reserved**: a dashed outline, with the time, the guest and the party size of the reservation it is held for. - **Bill**: the bill was printed after the last round, so the guests are waiting to pay. Red ring that pulses. It clears when the order is paid, or when more items are sent. The legend at the bottom of the plan counts the tables in each state."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Edit the plan","key":"md_edit_the_plan","id":"edit-the-plan","name":"md_edit_the_plan","value":"# Edit the plan Tap the **pencil** at the top left. In edit mode: - **+** in the rooms bar adds a room. **Edit** lets you rename the room or give it its own **menu**. - **+ Table** (top left of the plan) places a new table in the room. Drag it where it goes and pull its corner to resize it. - Each table has buttons to change its **shape** (square or round), open its **settings** and delete it. - **+ Production center** in the right column adds a station to the floor. - At the top right of the plan, **Edit** and **Delete** change the current room and **Menu** opens the [Menu Manager](/Docs/Menus%20and%20Items). Tap the pencil again to finish. Changes are saved as you go and appear on every open screen."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Table settings","key":"md_table_settings","id":"table-settings","name":"md_table_settings","value":"# Table settings - **Description**: the name shown on the table (T-1, 12, Patio 3). It must be unique within the restaurant; another branch can reuse it. - **No of Seats** and **Minimum Seating**: used to suggest tables for reservations. - **Color**. - **Customer**: a regular or a house account that the table's orders use instead of the walk-in customer."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Special tables","key":"md_special_tables","id":"special-tables","name":"md_special_tables","value":"# Special tables Create tables for orders that don't sit anywhere, usually in a *Counter* or *Delivery* room: - **Delivery**: where phone and online delivery orders land ([Delivery](/Docs/Delivery)). - **Pickup**: where online pickup orders land ([Online ordering](/Docs/Online%20Ordering)). - **Bar tabs**, **To go**: any table you need."}},{"node":"markdown107","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Table QR codes","key":"md_table_qr_codes","id":"table-qr-codes","name":"md_table_qr_codes","value":"# Table QR codes Each table has a QR code that opens its ordering page on the guest's phone. Managers print them all from **Restaurant workspace → Table QR Codes**. See [Online and QR ordering](/Docs/Online%20Ordering)."}}]}]
